messages:
kevin_sales: Hey team — Acme's vendor-risk wants detailed BCP/DR answers in the SIG/CAIQ. They asked specifically for RTO/RPO by deployment, backup cadence + retention, failover procedure + last test evidence, and uptime/SLA proof. Can we assemble short canned answers + artifacts? @maria_cust_success can you pull the test PDFs and runbook excerpts?

jamie_engineer: Yep. I can draft short answers and attach the runbook excerpt + the failover test log (internal test 2026-06-12).

jamie_engineer: Draft (feel free to trim to SIG length):
```
Hosted (Redwood API): RTO <= 60s for automated cross-region failover (typical measured recovery 60–120s in internal tests); RPO = 0 for KV/prefix cache through multi-region replication; backups: daily snapshots, incremental every 4 hours, 30-day retention; backups replicated to secondary region. SLA: 99.95% uptime for hosted endpoints (see SLA doc).

Dedicated: Customers get reserved GPU pools with optional cross-region replication. With cross-region enabled, internal tests show RTO typically <5 min; RPO depends on replication config (near-zero with sync replication). Backups: customer-configurable; we recommend daily snapshots + 90-day retention.

Private (VPC/on-prem): Redwood provides runbooks, automation tooling, and guidance for DR; final RTO/RPO depend on customer infrastructure and network. We assist with validation testing and can supply test artifacts.
```

anna_security: This is a good start. For the SIG/CAIQ we need source-of-truth artifacts: runbook PDF, the DR test report (with timeline + metrics), backup manifest (filenames + checksums), and a mapping to our SOC2/PCI controls. Also please add the exact CAIQ control IDs you are answering (e.g., DR-01, DR-02) so reviewers can cross-ref.

maria_cust_success: On it — I'll pull the runbook excerpt and the June failover report, then upload. ETA EOD. I will also request the ops timeline export for the incident.

jamie_engineer: Quick note for canned language: avoid absolute promises for Private deployments — use "customer-specific RTO" wording and offer validation testing. For Hosted we can be explicit with numbers.

kevin_sales: Perfect. Can someone convert Jamie's draft into 3x SIG-sized paragraphs (one per CAIQ DR item) I can paste into the questionnaire? Need concise answers + locations of artifacts.

dr_test_bot: DR test report uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/DR/2026-06-12-failover-report.pdf (sha256: abc123def456...). Runbook excerpt uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/runbooks/DR-excerpt-2026-04.pdf

anna_security: Thanks. Also ask ops to export the Grafana panel snapshots for the test (latency, RPS, error rate) and include timestamps. Vendor-risk will ask for the metrics slice that shows the exact failover window.

jamie_engineer: Will export a 15-min slice around the test and generate a one-paragraph summary: peak RPS, failover start/end, and error spike duration. Posting by 14:00 PT.

maria_cust_success: Drafted SIG answers (short):
- Hosted: "Redwood Hosted runs an active-passive, cross-region topology with automated failover. Internal DR exercises on 2026-06-12 measured recovery between 60–120 seconds. Backups: incremental every 4h, daily snapshots retained 30 days; snapshots replicated to a secondary region. SLA: 99.95%. Artifacts: failover report + snapshot manifest (links provided)."
- Dedicated: "Dedicated customers may enable cross-region replication. With replication enabled, typical internal recovery measured <5 minutes; RPO depends on replication mode. Backups configurable by customer; recommended daily snapshots + 90-day retention. Artifacts: config export + test logs."
- Private (VPC/on-prem): "Redwood supplies the DR runbook, automation scripts, and guidance; RTO/RPO are dependent on customer infrastructure. We offer validation tests and will provide artifacts from those tests. Artifacts: runbook excerpt + test playbook."

kevin_sales: These are great — short & SIG-friendly. Anna, will those artifacts + metrics satisfy vendor-risk?

anna_security: Yes, but include access control evidence (who accessed the artifacts during the test) and manifest checksums. Also add a sentence mapping these items to CAIQ fields. After that we can mark the SIG responses as ready.

maria_cust_success: I'll add ACL exports and manifest checksums to the uploads and then paste final links here. :thumbsup:

jamie_engineer: Added the Grafana summary & metrics export: s3://redwood-artifacts/DR/metrics-2026-06-12.json

kevin_sales: Awesome — once the links are here I'll populate the spreadsheet and send to Acme. Thanks team! :tada:
